sql: SELECT SUM(sales_amount),COUNT(*) FROM sales_orders WHERE order_date>='2025-01-01' AND order_date<'2026-01-01' AND region='华东'
SELECT region,SUM(sales_amount) AS v FROM sales_orders WHERE order_date>='2025-01-01' AND order_date<'2026-01-01' GROUP BY region ORDER BY v DESC
